decisions.reason: The candidate still requires permanent badges to be visible; replacing one badge and changing icon rules does not alter that visibility requirement.
Replacing First Mint with First Referral changes a badge achievement, not ticket issuance, counters, eligibility windows, or reset behavior.
The new First Referral badge does not change the commission amount, recipient, trigger, or automatic payout mode.
The badge-set change does not alter reward allocation when a primary mint has no referral code.
Badge names and icons do not change secondary-sale royalty destinations or ticket-generation rules.
The source changes achievement badge presentation, not the Project Rebuild product name.
The phrase Growing Network names a badge and does not change deployment to the Base network.
The badge change does not alter Big Block prize amounts, winner count, pool target, trigger, or royalty contribution.
Replacing an achievement badge does not change the manual prize-collection method.
The source does not change random winner selection, ticket weighting, or block-specific eligibility.
The badge-set and icon changes do not alter the Small Block prize mechanism.
The achievement badge decision does not affect the fiat on-ramp provider, conversion, or supported buyer type.
